# Bonk

> Writes bootable images (Linux, BSD, Windows) to USB drives, from each publisher's own files checked by SHA-256. MIT licence. Linux, Windows, macOS, Android (beta).

- [Systems](https://bonk-os.app/images/): catalog of images, official links and hashes
- [Download](https://bonk-os.app/install/): packages and command-line reference
- [Source](https://github.com/FantasmaGlad/Bonk)
- [Catalog (JSON, signed)](https://catalog.bonk-os.app/v2/catalog.json)
